milestone.describes: Level 1 is being played: the tower stands over the Lives/Score HUD, and each tapped block shatters with particles and a score popup while the rest topples.

steps.expect: The title menu, with PLAY on it. This app is slow to reach it; the note allows about 18 s.
SELECT LEVEL: a 20-tile grid under a header showing total score and stars.
Level 1: a tower of blocks over the Lives/Score HUD.
The block shatters into particles, a score popup (+20 or -20) rises, and the blocks above fall.
A second block removed, more physics.
A third block removed. The loop is running and persisting, which is the milestone.

notes: Coordinates are client coordinates for the 320x480 portrait window.

Levels are randomly generated, so the tower differs between runs. The three block coordinates are places a block was standing when this was recorded, not fixed targets: a tap on empty space simply does nothing. Judge the milestone by whether tapping removes blocks at all, not by these exact points.
The rising-bonus tutorial overlay can appear over the level. The game keeps running behind it and it does not block the route.
